planner:
Read the notebook entry below. Identify the sample ID, the measurement temperature
in kelvin, the sample concentration in millimolar, and the measurement method.
If a value is not stated in the entry, use the lookup tool to retrieve it.
When you are done, respond with a single JSON object with the keys sample_id,
temperature_K, concentration_mM and method, and nothing else.
system:
You are a careful laboratory data-extraction assistant. You read lab notebook
entries and produce structured records. Convert units when necessary: report
temperature in kelvin and concentration in millimolar.
tool_policy:
Look up one metadata field recorded alongside the notebook entry. Use it only for
values that are not stated in the entry text; each call costs budget.
